title: Malaysian Chicken Biryani
description: A flavorful chicken dish made with aromatic spices and served with fragrant basmati rice
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the Malaysian curry paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and oozing curry sauce. Bring to a simmer.
Reduce heat to low and cook, covered, for 10 minutes.
Stir in the cooked basmati rice and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Garnish with chopped cilantro and serve hot.
